'''2006 Kashyyyk Regional''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG regional championship held on 14 January 2006 at Scholars Books and Games, 34 Central Square, Bridgewater, Massachusetts, with [[Michael Pistone]] as tournament director.<ref name="pcf-8547-116749">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=116749#116749 Kashyyyk Regionals January 14th], Michael Pistone (Pistone84), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (2 January 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618100105/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=117140&highlight= Internet Archive]</ref> It was an [[Open]] format event with two byes to the [[2006 World Championship]] at stake;<ref name="pcf-8547-116749" /> they went to [[Greg Shaw]] and [[John Ferguson]].<ref name="pcf-9443-130633">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=130633#130633 Qualifiers for Worlds 2006], Mike Carr (mc9457), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (3 April 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618055549/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=141112 Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-9443-134248">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=134248#134248 Qualifiers for Worlds 2006], Michael Pistone (Pistone84), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (29 April 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618055549/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=141112 Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Scholars Books and Games, 34 Central Square, Bridgewater, Massachusetts; play was moved to the hall down the street from the store<ref name="pcf-8547-116749" /><ref name="pcf-8547-116850">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=116850#116850 Kashyyyk Regionals January 14th], Michael Pistone (Pistone84), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (3 January 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618100105/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=117140&highlight= Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Dates:''' 14 January 2006<ref name="pcf-8547-116749" />
* '''Time:''' registration 11 am; start 12 pm<ref name="pcf-8547-116749" />
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]; decklists required; clear sleeves not allowed<ref name="pcf-8547-116749" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $15, which "can be less with a good turnout"<ref name="pcf-8547-116850" />
* '''Prizes:''' uncut sheets, tournament foils and packs; two byes for the 2006 World Championship<ref name="pcf-8547-116749" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Michael Pistone]]<ref name="pcf-8547-116749" />

== Organization ==

Pistone posted the announcement on 2 January 2006,<ref name="pcf-8547-116749" /> and [[Erik Markarian]] reposted it on Essential SWCCG.<ref name="pcf-8547-116978">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=116978#116978 Kashyyyk Regionals January 14th], Erik Markarian, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (3 January 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618100105/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=117140&highlight= Internet Archive]</ref> Pistone ruled out an event on the Sunday because of the NFL playoffs, and offered a small four-game warm-up tournament on the Friday if enough players could commit to it.<ref name="pcf-8547-117085">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=117085#117085 Kashyyyk Regionals January 14th], Michael Pistone (Pistone84), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (3 January 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618100105/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=117140&highlight= Internet Archive]</ref>

== Results ==

The Players Committee's qualifier list for the 2006 World Championship, kept by [[Michael Carr|Mike Carr]], gives the two Kashyyyk qualifiers as Greg Shaw and John Ferguson;<ref name="pcf-9443-130633" /> Pistone confirmed the two names on 29 April 2006.<ref name="pcf-9443-134248" /> No winner or standings were posted in the topics read.
